Then: your TrustSquare page
Your advert is live the moment you tap Publish in Quick. It then lives in the TrustSquare app, where you add your team's photos, your licences and references. Introductions come to you; you choose which jobs to take.
You stay anonymous. People see your advert, never your name, number or address, until you decide to accept their introduction.
